categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Caiqin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end advanced electronic ceramic components, including filters, resonators, antennas, and supplementary products such as low intermodulation passive components, high-performance ceramic structures, RF modules, and systems. These products serve various sectors including mobile communications, radar, RF circuits, satellite communications, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductors, IoT, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary microwave dielectric ceramic powder formulations and advanced manufacturing technologies such as high-performance dielectric waveguide filters, large-size dielectric filter manufacturing and assembly, complex ceramic one-time molding, blind hole metallization and silver brazing, TEM dielectric filter technology, high-Q dielectric resonators, dielectric antennas, and low intermodulation passive components. Production covers the entire process from ceramic powder preparation to finished components, enabling flexible multi-variety production. The company also develops HTCC (High Temperature Co-fired Ceramic) products with advanced manufacturing capabilities including minimum layer thickness and fine feature sizes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading communication equipment manufacturers such as Huawei, Comba Telecom, Qualcomm, China Information and Communication Technology Group, Nokia, and Ericsson. The company also serves prominent aerospace and defense enterprises like China Electronics Technology Group Corporation and Aviation Industry Corporation of China. Its products are widely used in mobile communication base stations, radar, satellite navigation, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductor, IoT, and consumer electronics markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in regions including South China, East China, North China, Southwest China, and other domestic areas. It also has some overseas sales. Its headquarters and main production facilities are located in Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Caiqin Technology operates upstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of core electronic ceramic components and modules used by communication equipment manufacturers and other downstream industries. It controls the entire production process from raw material preparation to finished product delivery, positioning itself as a key upstream supplier in the RF component industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding its microwave dielectric ceramic material system, HTCC high-end electronic ceramics, and advanced ceramic processing technologies. Strategic priorities include consolidating its leading position in mobile communication base station ceramic RF components, expanding applications in new energy, semiconductors, IoT, consumer electronics, and robotics. It aims to develop high-performance, miniaturized, reliable, low-power, and cost-effective ceramic products and solutions aligned with 5G, 5G-Advanced, and future 6G technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized electronic ceramic components and modules to communication equipment manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with sales framework agreements and batch orders. It also generates income from government subsidies, investment income, and financial asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier of microwave dielectric ceramic components, particularly dielectric waveguide filters for 5G base stations, competing with firms like Wuhan Fanggu, Dongshan Precision, Chunxing Precision, Dafu Technology, Guoren Communication, and Aifu Electronics. It holds a strong market position with recognized technological advantages and scale in the upstream RF ceramic component industry, surpassing many foreign competitors in certain product segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 410.9 million, a year-on-year increase of 11.09%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 57.79 million, up 23.66%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.57 billion, growing 9.24% from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 9.63% of revenue. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by new product launches, market expansion, and improved operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Caiqin Technology differentiates itself through proprietary ceramic powder formulations and advanced manufacturing processes that yield high-Q, low-loss, temperature-stable, miniaturized, and cost-effective dielectric filters and resonators. Its products offer superior electrical performance, reliability, and scalability for 4G, 5G, and emerging 5G-Advanced networks. The company’s vertical integration and flexible production enable customized solutions with rapid delivery, supporting leading communication equipment manufacturers and defense clients. Its commitment to innovation and quality has earned multiple industry awards and patents, reinforcing its competitive edge.
